hints.title: Earliest Expiration Priority
hints.text: Always choose to eat an apple that will rot earliest to leave fresher apples for later.

hints.title: Priority Management
hints.text: Maintain batches of apples in an ordered structure keyed by their expiration date.

hints.title: Simulate Day by Day
hints.text: On each day, discard batches where expiration <= current day, then consume one apple from earliest expiring batch.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of apples array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-evaluating all available apples linearly each day takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min-heap ordered by expiration date yields O(log n) insertions and extractions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements greedy earliest-deadline-first strategy with min-heap.
